legal.dataControllerDesc: {company} ({address}) is the data controller responsible for the processing of your personal data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
legal.dataAccount: Account data: email address, OAuth identifiers (Google)
legal.dataPet: Pet data: name, species, breed, health records, symptom logs
legal.dataUsage: Usage data: app interactions, feature usage, language preferences
legal.dataPayment: Payment data: processed securely by Stripe (we do not store card numbers)
legal.legalBasisDesc: We process your data under GDPR Article 6: (a) your consent for account creation and data processing, (b) performance of the contract for providing the service, and (f) our legitimate interests for service improvement and security.
legal.dataStorageDesc: Your data is stored securely using Lovable Cloud infrastructure, which employs encryption at rest and in transit. Servers are located in the EU or regions with adequate data protection agreements.
legal.dataRetentionDesc: We retain your data for as long as your account is active. Upon account deletion, all personal data is permanently erased within 30 days. Anonymized, aggregated data may be retained for analytics.
legal.userRightsDesc: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
legal.rightAccess: Right of access: request a copy of your personal data
legal.rightRectification: Right to rectification: correct inaccurate data
legal.rightErasure: Right to erasure (right to be forgotten): request deletion of your data
legal.rightPortability: Right to data portability: receive your data in a machine-readable format (CSV export)
legal.rightRestriction: Right to restriction of processing: limit how we use your data
legal.exerciseRights: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at {email}.
legal.internationalTransfersDesc: When data is transferred outside the EU/EEA, we ensure adequate safeguards are in place, including Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission.
legal.securityDesc: We implement industry-standard security measures including encryption (TLS/SSL), secure authentication, Row-Level Security for database access, and regular security audits to protect your data.
legal.complaintsDesc: If you believe your data protection rights have been violated, you may lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (Agencia Española de Protección de Datos – AEPD) at www.aepd.es.
legal.serviceDescriptionText: PetCare Pocket is a pet health management application developed by Kaizenith (Spain). It allows users to track pet health records, vaccinations, medications, vet visits, reminders, and symptoms.
legal.planLimitationsText: The Free plan is limited to 1 pet and 10 records per category (vaccines, medications, visits). The Premium plan (4.99€/month) provides unlimited pets, unlimited records, advanced reminders, and an ad-free experience.
legal.medicalDisclaimerText: PetCare Pocket is NOT a veterinary medical service. The Symptom Checker provides general informational guidance only and does not constitute veterinary advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a licensed veterinarian for your pet's health needs. In case of emergency, contact your nearest veterinary clinic immediately. Kaizenith accepts no liability for health decisions made based on information provided by this application.
legal.acceptableUseText: You agree to use the service only for lawful purposes and in accordance with these terms. You must not use the service to store or transmit illegal content, attempt to gain unauthorized access, or interfere with the service's operation.
legal.intellectualPropertyText: All content, design, and source code of PetCare Pocket are the property of Kaizenith. You may not reproduce, distribute, or create derivative works from any part of the service without express written permission.
legal.subscriptionTermsText: Premium subscriptions are billed monthly via Stripe. Subscriptions auto-renew at the end of each billing cycle unless cancelled. You may cancel at any time through your account settings or the Stripe customer portal. Cancellations take effect at the end of the current billing period. No refunds are provided for partial billing periods.
legal.limitationOfLiabilityText: Kaizenith provides the service 'as is' without warranties of any kind. To the maximum extent permitted by law, Kaizenith shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from the use of or inability to use the service.
legal.governingLawText: These terms are governed by the laws of Spain. Any disputes shall be resolved in the courts of Spain, without prejudice to any mandatory consumer protection provisions of your country of residence.
legal.whatAreCookiesText: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. Local storage and session storage are similar browser technologies used to store data locally.
legal.cookiesWeUseText: PetCare Pocket uses only essential cookies and local storage necessary for the application to function:
legal.essentialCookiesDesc: Used to keep you logged in securely. Managed by Lovable Cloud authentication. Duration: session-based.
legal.stripeCookiesDesc: Stripe may set cookies during the payment process for fraud prevention and security. These are managed by Stripe.
legal.noTrackingCookiesText: We do not use any analytics, advertising, or marketing tracking cookies. No third-party trackers are embedded in this application. We do not track your browsing behavior across websites.
legal.manageCookiesText: You can manage or delete cookies through your browser settings. Note that disabling essential cookies may prevent the application from functioning correctly.
legal.cookieConsentDesc: PetCare Pocket uses only essential cookies for authentication and app functionality. No marketing or tracking cookies are used.
